name: LOVATO EXCCON02 communication converter
summary: RS485-to-Ethernet communication converter for connecting serial devices to a network.
description: Mount the converter where both serial wiring and the Ethernet patch lead can reach it without crossing high-current terminals. Include its mounting kit when measuring the equipment envelope.
Use the linked manufacturer CAD for dimensions and the exact selected configuration. The downloadable illustration here is original educational geometry, unitless and not to scale.
readingNotes: DIN-rail and rear-mount arrangements are documented. Cable connectors and their release tabs need access beyond the body outline.
The converter performs a communications function; it is not a protective relay or an unmanaged Ethernet switch.
drawingChecklist: Check rail or rear mounting selection.
Allow Ethernet plug and serial terminal access.
Identify power supply and Modbus network interfaces.
